daily_summary: 当日 vLLM 变更以「回滚 + 前端/配置清理 + 平台默认值调整 + 定点性能优化」为主。最重的一次是对 #56956（DSpark 在聚合式服务中支持 PP 目标）的完整回滚，连带移除 PPHandler 的 draft 广播/16 字节对齐 combined buffer/warmup_pp_decode_update、DFlash 的 is_padding 机制、dsv4_topk/fused_topk_bias 的 padding 掩码支持，属于对 GPUModelRunner/InputBatch 的破坏性 API 回退。前端方向删除了 slow tokenizer 模式，并大规模推进 Transformers v5 命名迁移（218 个文件，PretrainedConfig→PreTrainedConfig、*ImageProcessorFast→TorchvisionBackend，并新增 pre-commit 禁止旧名），同时修正 Hub revision 解析（每个仓库各自 pin）与 presence/frequency penalty 服务端默认值被静默丢弃两个配置语义问题。性能方向包括 FlashInfer prefill FP8 反量化 scratch 绑定、ROCm DSv4.1 稀疏 decode 直接产出 MXFP8 并走 grouped FP8 wo_a GEMM、流式 derender 的增量 detokenization 下放到线程池。平台侧 XPU Graph 改为默认开启（删除 VLLM_XPU_ENABLE_XPU_GRAPH）并补齐 CPU AVX10.2 的编译器能力探测。其余为测试/CI/依赖与仓库卫生清理。
ascend_impact_summary: 当日对 vllm-ascend 有实质影响的只有对 #56956 的回滚：它删除了 GPUModelRunner.warmup_pp_decode_update()、去掉了 vllm.v1.worker.gpu.input_batch.post_update() 与 GPUModelRunner.post_update() 的 broadcast_drafts/draft_tokens_out 参数、回退了 PPHandler.set_disabled()/broadcast_drafts() 的语义（含 _alloc_combined 对齐缓冲）以及 DFlash 的 is_padding 输入与 dsv4_topk/fused_topk_bias 的 padding 掩码支持。vllm-ascend 的 NPUModelRunner(V2) 直接继承 GPUModelRunner，且 vllm_ascend/spec_decode 中存在 DFlash/DSpark proposer 实现，同步上游时必须一并回退这些调用与断言。其余变更不触及 Ascend 实现的 Platform/Worker/Attention/Communicator/KVCacheSpec 等接口：既有 Transformers v5 更名（旧名在 v5 中仍保留为别名，且 check_forbidden_imports 只作用于 vllm 仓库）、OpenAI 协议与 ModelConfig 的默认值/校验修正（平台无关，行为对所有平台一致），也有纯 CUDA/ROCm/XPU/CPU 平台特定实现（FlashInfer TRT-LLM 反量化 scratch、ROCm MXFP8 wo_a、XPU Graph 默认开启、CPU AVX10.2 探测）和文档/CI/依赖清理，因此无需 Ascend 侧代码或测试改动。

commits.comment: 回滚 #56956（[DSpark] 在聚合式服务中支持流水线并行目标），共 11 个文件、-629 行。回滚内容分三块：(1) PP 侧把 last rank 的采样结果/draft token 广播给前序 rank 的机制——PPHandler 去掉 disabled/set_disabled()、恢复旧版 broadcast_drafts()（在 main stream 上 gather `draft_tokens[input_batch.idx_mapping]`）、删除 `_alloc_combined()` 的 16 字节对齐 combined 缓冲、`_post_update_kernel`/`post_update()` 去掉 broadcast_drafts/draft_tokens_out 参数、删除 `GPUModelRunner.warmup_pp_decode_update()` 及 GPUWorker 中 warmup 期间的 set_disabled 开合；(2) DFlash 的 padding 机制——`prepare_dflash_inputs`/`_prepare_dflash_inputs_kernel` 不再输出 is_padding，speculator 前向不再传 is_padding；(3) 路由侧 padding 掩码——dsv4_topk 的 is_padding/-1 sentinel 与 HAS_PADDING 常量、fused_topk_bias 中的 padding_mask 判定（含 uint32 索引回退分支）全部移除。风险：这是对上游 GPUModelRunner/InputBatch 的破坏性变更（方法被删除、post_update 关键字参数消失、is_padding 语义消失），任何继承或 monkey-patch 这些点的下游实现（vllm-ascend 的 NPUModelRunner、DFlash/DSpark proposer、以及 fork 了 pp_utils/dflash 单测的项目）在同步上游后必须一起回退，否则会在运行期因未知 kwargs/Triton kernel 参数不匹配而失败；同时 PP + spec decode 场景会丧失此前引入的固定形状广播与 padding 行剔除优化。

commits.comment: FlashInfer/TRT-LLM prefill 的 KV-FP8 反量化 scratch 绑定。FlashInferMetadataBuilder.build() 中，当 query 未量化（q_data_type_prefill != FP8）且 cache 为 fp8 时，先把 prefill 的 block_table 按实际会访问的页数裁剪并 contiguous：宽度取 cdiv(max_prefill_seq_len, page_size)，而 max_prefill_seq_len 优先用 common_attn_metadata.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound（host 侧长度上界），缺失时回退 max_seq_len，并用 canonicalize_singleton_dim_strides 规范化 stride。这样 trtllm_prefill_attn_kvfp8_dequant 只为「真正的 prefill KV」分配一页/表项的 scratch，而不再按 block_table 的全部容量（如 CUDA graph 预留的 256 列）分配。新增测试覆盖 block_size 16/64/128、有/无 host 长度上界、是否量化 query 共 5 种组合，断言表是严格连续、内容等于 block_table_tensor[1:, :width]、scratch 形状为 num_prefills*live_pages+1，并特意把未使用列的 page id 填成非零以证明它们不会被读。风险：裁剪列数强依赖 seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound 是「上界」这一契约，若上界小于真实长度会漏读页（正确性风险），因此该字段语义不能被削弱；非 fp8 cache 与量化 query 的路径完全不受影响。

commits.comment: ROCm/gfx950 上 DeepSeek-V4.1 稀疏 MLA 的性能优化：让 sparse decode 的 split-K reduce 直接在 kernel 内产出 MXFP8（e4m3 data + E8M0 scale，每 32 元素一个 block），供 wo_a 的 FP8 GEMM 直接消费。具体包括：(1) `_sparse_attn_decode_reduce_kernel` 新增 QUANT_OUT 分支与寄存器内 `_mxfp8_quantize_rows` / `_mxfp8_scale_bits`（与 `mxfp8_e4m3_quantize` 相同 rounding，测试用 torch.equal 校验 bit 一致），并用乘法代替除法避免 2**-127 下溢；（2) 新增 `rocm_inverse_rope_mxfp8_rows` 处理 prefill 行（bf16 注意力 → inverse RoPE → 量化），与 decode epilogue 对齐；(3) 新增 grouped MXFP8 wo_a GEMM `rocm_mxfp8_wo_a_bmm`（Triton `tl.dot_scaled`，按 num_tokens*n_groups 分档调优的 `_mxfp8_wo_a_bmm_config`，通过 `direct_register_custom_op` 注册 opaque op + fake impl，避免 tile 选择被 torch.compile 在 trace 时冻结）；(4) `DeepseekV41ROCMAiterMLAAttention._alloc_attn_out` 在 gfx950 上分配 e4m3/uint8 缓冲并返回 QuantizedActivation(kMxfp8Dynamic)，`forward_mqa`/`_o_proj` 支持 QuantizedActivation 输入，prefill/decode 路径共享一个 workspace 分配（get_simultaneous 一次调用，避免别名）。风险：全部被 _ON_GFX950 / 断言守卫，非 gfx950 自动回退原 bf16 路径；新增 opaque op 名称进入自定义 op 表，编译图依赖其 fake impl 的形状推断；MXFP8 量化精度由 reduce 的 fp32 输出决定，测试覆盖了与参考量化逐 bit 一致及端到端误差上界。

commits.comment: 修复 encoder cache 以 multimodal identifier（客户端 UUID）为键复用时的嵌入数量不匹配问题：不同内容的图片/输入若复用同一 UUID，会命中数量不符的缓存条目并错位使用 encoder embeddings。实现上 EncoderCacheManager 新增 num_embeds_by_hash（mm_hash -> 嵌入数）与 get_cached_num_encoder_embeds()，在 reset/evict/free 中同步维护与清理，allocate 时用 setdefault 做一致性断言，free 时改用记录值而非重新向 request 查询（避免 request 状态变化导致记账漂移）。Scheduler 侧新增 encoder_cache_mismatch_reqs 集合与 _reject_on_encoder_cache_embed_mismatch()：在 _try_schedule_encoder_inputs 中把 mm_hashes_to_schedule 从 set 改为 dict[identifier, num_embeds]，既校验“同一步内同一 identifier 两次出现但嵌入数不同”，也校验“命中已有缓存但嵌入数不同”；一旦发现不匹配就记录并返回空调度结果，update_from_output 会把该 request 作为 ERROR 结束（复用 grammar_compile_error_reqs 的机制），同时保持缓存/可释放槽位记账不被污染（有专门单测覆盖“先命中后又失败”的回滚场景）。风险点在于这是行为收紧：依赖 UUID 复用做跨请求 encoder 复用的客户端现在会被明确报错而非静默错算，属正确的 fail-fast，但需注意失败路径的 slot 记账回滚逻辑较复杂，测试已覆盖部分回滚场景。

affected_interfaces: vllm.v1.core.sched.scheduler.Scheduler (new `encoder_cache_mismatch_reqs` state and `_reject_on_encoder_cache_embed_mismatch()`; consumed in `update_from_outputs` and `_try_schedule_encoder_inputs`)
deep_analysis.adaptation_guide:
Update `vllm_ascend/ec_manager/score_ec_manager.py` (ScoreEncoderCacheManager) to keep the new upstream bookkeeping consistent, otherwise the migrated fix is silently bypassed (no crash, but the bug remains):
1. `allocate()` (line ~365): record `self.num_embeds_by_hash[mm_hash] = request.get_num_encoder_embeds(input_id)` with an assertion matching the upstream base (mirror `EncoderCacheManager.allocate`).
2. `reset()` (line ~496): clear `self.num_embeds_by_hash`.
3. Whenever an mm_hash is fully evicted from `self.cached`, also delete it from `num_embeds_by_hash`: in `can_allocate()` CPU eviction (line ~339, `self.cached.pop(mm_hash, None)`) and in `evict_from_npu()` (line ~184, `self.cached.pop(ent.mm_hash, None)`), to avoid stale counts causing spurious mismatch rejections.
Rationale: `ScoreEncoderCacheManager` inherits the new `get_cached_num_encoder_embeds()` but overrides `allocate`/`reset`, so the inherited lookup currently always returns None and `Scheduler._try_schedule_encoder_inputs` will never apply the new mismatch rejection when the Ascend score EC manager is enabled.
Also verify (no change expected): the Ascend scheduler forks (`RecomputeScheduler`, `DyntraLBScheduler`, `ProfilingChunkScheduler`, `BatchJobAwareScheduler`, `ShortRequestFirstScheduler`, and `patch/platform/patch_balance_schedule.py`) all call `super().__init__()` (so `encoder_cache_mismatch_reqs` exists) and inherit the base `_try_schedule_encoder_inputs`/`update_from_outputs`, so the new error handling flows through them. Add/extend `tests/ut/core/test_score_encoder_cache_manager.py` to assert the cached embed count is tracked and that `get_cached_num_encoder_embeds` returns the expected value after allocate/free/reset.
deep_analysis.risk: low-to-medium. No crash or signature break: `super().__init__()` initializes the new dict and the new scheduler state, and the modified scheduler methods are inherited. The primary risk is behavioral: without maintaining `num_embeds_by_hash`, the upstream stale-embedding rejection is a no-op for Ascend's ScoreEncoderCacheManager, so a client-reused multimodal identifier with a different embedding count can still serve mismatched cached embeddings. Incorrect eviction cleanup of the new map could instead cause spurious request rejections.

vllm-ascend monkey-patches the exact code this commit changes: vllm_ascend/patch/platform/patch_speculative_config.py sets SpeculativeConfig.__post_init__ = _dspark_post_init and SpeculativeConfig.hf_config_override = _normalize_legacy_qwen3_dspark_config. _dspark_post_init calls the captured upstream _orig_post_init, so it transparently inherits the new behavior: for method='dspark' upstream now sets num_speculative_tokens from draft_hf_config.block_size (fallback dspark_block_size) instead of overwriting n_predict with dspark_block_size, and no longer runs the n_predict divisibility check. No functional patch change is required, but do the following:
1) Confirm _normalize_deepseek_dspark_draft (patch_speculative_config.py:110-175) does not rely on the removed n_predict override. It currently sets n_mtp_layers from num_nextn_predict_layers and the DSpark models (vllm_ascend/models/deepseek_v4/dspark.py:84, deepseek_v41/dspark.py:152) derive width from dspark_block_size, so this is consistent — keep it that way.
2) Verify AscendDSparkProposer (vllm_ascend/spec_decode/dspark_proposer.py:41-69,114-124,246,299,418) receives the correct num_speculative_tokens for DeepSeek V4/V4.1, Qwen3 and Gemma4 DSpark when the user does not pass --num-speculative-tokens; the new upstream default must equal the NPU draft width (dspark_block_size) or the proposer buffers/acceptance metrics will be mis-sized.
3) Add a regression test (extend tests/ut/patch/platform/test_patch_speculative_config_dspark.py, which currently mocks _orig_post_init and therefore does not cover the new width derivation) asserting that DSpark num_speculative_tokens is independent of num_nextn_predict_layers while MTP still enforces the divisibility check.
4) Watch the new upstream lookup order block_size before dspark_block_size: DeepSeek checkpoints expose dspark_block_size (no standard block_size field in vllm/transformers_utils/configs/deepseek_v4*.py), so if an NPU DeepSeek checkpoint ever carries an unrelated block_size, guard the derivation.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. The change is behaviorally transparent for the current DSpark configs (DeepSeek uses dspark_block_size, Qwen3/Gemma4 use block_size; block_size is checked first). The main risk is silent mis-sizing: if num_speculative_tokens no longer matches the NPU DSpark width (e.g. because block_size takes precedence in a future config, or because the divisibility guard that previously caught mismatches is gone for method='dspark'), the Ascend DSpark proposer's query/root-index buffers and acceptance statistics (dspark_proposer.py) would be wrongly sized or acceptance would silently regress. Existing vllm-ascend e2e tests always pass num_speculative_tokens explicitly, so this default path is currently untested on NPU.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit changes the shared interface AttentionBackend.get_supported_kernel_block_sizes() to accept an optional kv_cache_spec argument, and upstream now invokes it positionally via _largest_kernel_block_within() in vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/attention.py (sliding-window branch of Attention.get_kv_cache_spec). vllm-ascend overrides this static method with a zero-argument signature in 16 places, so any Ascend model whose generic vLLM Attention layer has a sliding window (e.g. the registered Ascend Gemma4 models via vllm_ascend/models/gemma4_mm.py, and other SWA models) will hit a TypeError: get_supported_kernel_block_sizes() takes 0 positional arguments but 1 was given during KV-cache spec construction. Required change: add a trailing optional parameter (kv_cache_spec: "KVCacheSpec | None" = None) to every override listed in affected_interfaces and ignore it (Ascend block sizes do not depend on the spec). No behavior change is needed in the returned values. Concretely edit: vllm_ascend/attention/attention_v1.py:143, mla_v1.py:121, sfa_v1.py:396, dsa_v1.py:272/282/294/306/316/326, fa3_v1.py:38, indexer.py:160, indexer_kpool.py:239/348, models/minimax_m3/msa_m3.py:142/707, _310p/attention/attention_v1.py:98. Also update test stubs that supply the callable to code paths which now pass the spec (e.g. SimpleNamespace(get_supported_kernel_block_sizes=lambda: ...) in tests/ut/_310p/test_model_runner_310p.py and any mock configured for the upstream Attention path). The unrelated NVIDIA-only parts of the commit (flash_attn.py FA4/SM90 FP8 block-size logic, fa_utils.flash_attn_supports_kv_cache_dtype, vllm_flash_attn fp8-KV dequant, Gemma4Config SM90 branch, and the GPU Gemma4 speculator _copy_target_kv_scales) do not require Ascend adaptation.
deep_analysis.risk: medium. The change is mechanical and each edit is behavior-preserving, but it is cross-cutting (16 override sites plus test doubles) and a single missed override causes a hard startup failure (TypeError) when building the KV-cache spec for any sliding-window model on NPU, including the currently supported Gemma4 family. The failure is only reachable through the generic vLLM Attention.get_kv_cache_spec sliding-window path (not the custom Ascend MLA/DSA layers), so validation should cover an SWA model end-to-end, not only MLA models. Because Ascend's returned block sizes are spec-independent, no numerical/accuracy risk is expected as long as the new parameter is accepted and ignored.

deep_analysis.adaptation_guide: The commit changes `InputBatch.make_dummy` so the dummy `idx_mapping` is `torch.int32` instead of `torch.int64`, matching the real path in vllm (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/model_runner.py:1327-1328` uses `dtype=torch.int32`). vllm-ascend subclasses this at `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/input_batch.py` (`AscendInputBatch.make_dummy` calls the base and re-wraps via `fields(InputBatch)`), so the dummy dtype is inherited transparently and that file needs no change. However, vllm-ascend's own real path at `vllm_ascend/worker/v2/model_runner.py:431` does `idx_mapping = async_copy_to_gpu(idx_mapping_np, device=self.device)` with no `dtype`, and `batch_req_state.idx_mapping_np` is `np.intp` (int64) from upstream `gather_batch_req_state`, so the real AscendInputBatch.idx_mapping stays int64. Before this commit dummy and real were both int64 on Ascend; after it they diverge (dummy int32 vs real int64), which reintroduces the exact Triton JIT specialization mismatch the upstream fix removes (kernels such as `_compute_slot_mappings_kernel` in vllm_ascend/worker/v2/block_table.py, upstream `expand_idx_mapping`, and the vllm_ascend sampling kernels load the `idx_mapping_ptr`). Fix: pass `dtype=torch.int32` in that call (`async_copy_to_gpu(idx_mapping_np, device=self.device, dtype=torch.int32)`), and audit other idx_mapping H2D copies for consistency, notably `vllm_ascend/patch/worker/patch_v2/patch_spec_pp.py:147,159`. No signature/semantic change is required in the AscendInputBatch/Ascend310PInputBatch overrides.
deep_analysis.risk: Low. It is a host-to-device dtype change for a small index tensor (request indices always fit in int32); torch/numpy indexing and the vllm_ascend Triton kernels accept int32. Main risk is a silent perf regression (extra JIT recompile) if vllm-ascend is left at int64 while the dummy lags at int32, which is exactly why the alignment is needed. Validate with an MRV2 ACL-graph decode/spec-decode run on NPU (dummy capture then real step) confirming no runtime Triton recompilation and unchanged accuracy.

_extra_check 依赖 match.nodes/match.output_nodes() 的 FX 内部结构，torch 版本升级可能影响稳定性；(c) uuid() 已把 QkNormMRopeKvCachePattern 与 _discover_mrope_configs 纳入 hash_source，编译缓存键处理正确；(d) config/compilation.py 与 config/vllm.py 仅改 docstring（把 O1+ 更正为 O2+，并说明 MRoPE 支持），无行为变更。整体上是 ROCm 专属优化，门控在 rocm_aiter_ops，但 AttentionImpl 接口扩展会影响所有继承该基类的后端。

ascend_impact.functionality: 命中『必然影响』路径 vllm/v1/attention/backend.py：AttentionImpl 抽象类新增两个方法——fused_qk_norm_mrope_kvcache_supported()（默认 return False）与 do_qk_norm_mrope_kvcache_update(layer, qkv, q_out, positions, q_weight, k_weight, rms_norm_eps, cos_sin_cache, is_neox, mrope_section, is_interleaved, rotary_dim, kv_cache, layer_slot_mapping)（默认 raise NotImplementedError）。vllm-ascend 的 AscendAttentionBackendImpl / AscendMLAImpl / AscendSFAImpl / AscendDSAImpl / AscendFABackendImpl 等均继承 AttentionImpl，因两个方法均带默认实现而非 @abstractmethod，导入与实例化不受影响，现有行为不变；由于默认 supports 返回 False，QkNormRopeKvCacheFusionPass 在 Ascend 上（即使被误注册 pattern）也不会对 Ascend 层启用 MRoPE 融合路径。另外两点：（1）QkNormRopeKvCacheFusionPass 本身受 ROCm/AITER 门控（vllm/config/vllm.py 的 enable_qk_norm_rope_kvcache 检查 rocm_aiter_ops.is_enabled()），Ascend 平台不会走该 pass，因此 PassConfig 中 fuse_qk_norm_rope_kvcache 的 docstring 修正与 rope_kvcache_fusion_max_token_num 语义变化对 Ascend 无实际作用；（2）vllm/model_executor/layers/rotary_embedding/mrope.py 新增的 torch.ops.vllm.mrope 只在 MRotaryEmbedding.forward_hip（ROCm/HIP 专属分支）中被调用，Ascend 走 forward_native 及自身 vllm_ascend/ops 下的 rotary/MRoPE 实现，不受影响。无需任何 vllm-ascend 侧的签名适配或 monkey-patch 更新。
ascend_impact.testing: vllm-ascend 无需改动测试：新增的 tests/compile/passes/test_rocm_aiter_qk_norm_rope_kvcache_fusion.py 用例全部 skipif(not IS_AITER_FOUND)，在 Ascend 环境不会执行；tests/compile/fusions_e2e/ 下对 norm_rope_fusion 计数逻辑的调整也仅影响 ROCm AITER 的 e2e 融合用例。Ascend 侧既不需要新增用例来覆盖新增接口，也不会因接口新增而失败。
